name: Overall Preference
insight: Mythos-class public debut at 1525 Elo. Fable 5 leads capability evals including 1932 GDPval-AA (Opus 4.8: 1890). First time this tier is available to normal users.

name: Coding & Engineering
insight: 95% on SWE-bench Verified and 80% on SWE-bench Pro. Clear step-change on long-horizon agentic coding and complex workflows; bigger gains as tasks get harder.

name: Hard Reasoning & Science
insight: Leads on PhD-level benchmarks like GPQA and ARC-AGI subsets. Claude and Grok are strong contenders.

name: Honest Daily Use
insight: Shines for maximally truthful, witty conversation. Great for brainstorming without corporate polish.
